main_text.head: EXORATIONIBUS, DE SEptem gaudiis corporalibus beatæ Mariæ virginis.
main_text.p: O Maria mater pia, Esto nobis recta via Ad tuum Filium.
Ac pro tua gratia, Depelle nostra vitia Per hoc sanctum gaudium.

p.i: Dulcis amica Dei, rosa vernans, stella decora, Tu memor esto mei, mortis dum venerit hora.

main_text.p: Venerandorum gaudiorum Domine gloriosæ genitricis tuæ sacrosanctæ semper virginis Mariæ memoriam recolentes, te supplices exoramus, ut ejus intervenientibus meritis, cœlestis consolationis participes, & gaudii, quo tecum modo lætatur, in futuro tribuas esse consortes.
main_text.head: DE SEPTEM GAUDIIS MARIÆ.
GRADUALE.
SEQUENTIA.

page.notes: The page shows some faded and damaged letters; the final line is partly obscured by a marginal "M" and a few words are uncertain, notably "Maria:" and the gaudium line. Long s rendered as s throughout. Italic passages marked in <i>.
